high.title: The Connector

quizzes.title: Night Owl
quizzes.hook: When does your brain actually come online?

low.description: You tend to feel clearer and more usable earlier in the day, especially with a consistent schedule.

mid.description: Your energy depends more on sleep and context than a fixed time of day, and you can adapt in either direction.

high.title: The Night Engine

quizzes.hook: What happens when tension enters the room?
